reason: The collagen framework and mineral look like complementary parts of bone, so combining them is a direct start toward a strong arm skeleton.
expectation: The mineral will strengthen the collagen framework.

effect: The framework now has mineral as well as collagen, showing how the two contribute different properties to bone. I’ll add its living components next.
reaction: The contrast between toughness and resistance to compression clarified why both materials matter.
reason: Bone cells are a visible component needed to make the mineralised framework living bone.
expectation: The bone cells will become part of the arm bones.

effect: The bone cells are embedded in the mineralised matrix. Blood vessels look like the next component needed for living bone.
reaction: The cutaway makes the cells’ place in the matrix clear, though it does not explain what they do.
reason: Blood vessels can supply the living bone tissue.
expectation: The vessels will become part of the arm bones.

effect: The vessels complete the living arm bones and show how their embedded cells are supplied. The elbow still needs smooth surfaces and support.
reaction: The explanation connects the vessels to the bone cells clearly.
reason: Articular cartilage looks suited to covering the bone ends where the elbow moves.
expectation: The cartilage will form smooth caps on the joint surfaces.

effect: The cartilage covers the facing elbow surfaces, making the joint's sliding surfaces clear. The capsule and ligaments remain to be added.
reaction: The sliding inset makes the cartilage's role easy to picture.
reason: The synovial capsule looks like the sleeve that surrounds the moving elbow joint.
expectation: The capsule will surround the cartilage-covered joint and provide a fluid-filled space.

effect: The capsule encloses the joint, and its lining supplies fluid that helps the cartilage-covered surfaces glide. The ligaments remain to support the elbow.
reaction: The explanation makes the capsule’s role clearer.
reason: The elbow ligaments are shown spanning the joint, so they fit the remaining need for support.
expectation: The ligaments will support the enclosed elbow joint.

effect: The ligaments completed the movable arm skeleton, showing how the elbow can bend while resisting sideways movement.
reaction: The arrows made the ligaments’ supporting role easy to understand.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding mineral to the collagen framework was most worthwhile because the result explained how the two materials give bone different properties.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding bone cells was the least informative passage: the cutaway showed where they sit but did not explain what they do.

surprise.text: I learned that the capsule’s lining supplies fluid that helps the cartilage-covered surfaces glide.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the item descriptions and goal gave each addition a clear place in the construction.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how the muscle and supported skeleton work together. The joint construction made that connection interesting.
